annotations.title: Query recipes (cuisine, ingredients, nutrition, diet, method, source, language)

description: The full recipe search: filter by country or cuisine, category, ingredients in or out, cooking method (baking, frying...), style, diet (vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, gluten_free...), no_allergens, diabetic_friendly, kids, source (a cook or book name), nutrition per serving or per whole recipe, cost tier, prep and cook time, servings, language; sort and page. Give have (ingredients the person has) for a "what can I cook with these" ranking. Diet, allergen, diabetic and kids flags are inferred or reviewed claims, never certifications or medical advice.

allergen_free.description: Comma list of declared allergens to exclude:

basis.description: published: with diet, only recipes classified by their publisher (safety.dietary);

category.description: Comma list, any may match: a book category (Soups, Eastern Desserts, Fish & Seafood, Quick Meals, Baking...) or a course.

cook_time_max.description: Maximum unattended minutes (cooking, resting, waiting): total time minus hands-on time.

cost_max.description: Maximum cost per serving in the catalog's unspecified unit (see /api/facets ranges).

cost_tier.description: Comma list: budget, mid, premium. Relative within this catalog, because the data states no currency.

country.description: Country or nationality: Egypt, Egyptian, Japan, India, Korea, Iran, Italy, Spain, Greece, Mexico, Morocco...

course.description: Comma list: main, dessert, side, salad, soup, bread, drink, breakfast, other.

cuisine.description: Comma list of country codes or names: EG, MX, JP, MA, CN, FR, VN, or Egyptian, Mexican, Japanese, Moroccan, Chinese, French, Vietnamese.

detail.description: brief (default) or full (adds ingredients, operations, equipment, tags, cost buckets).

diabetic_friendly.description: true: only recipes that look diabetic-friendly:

diet.description: Comma list, all must hold. Published classification where the recipe has one, otherwise an ingredient screen;

equipment.description: Comma list of equipment keywords, for example oven, hob, blender, grill.

exclude_ingredient.description: Comma list of ingredients that must not appear.

exclude_text.description: Comma list of words that must not appear in the title.

has_image.description: true to return only recipes with a photo.

has_notes.description: true: only recipes that have published background, history or tips.

has_nutrition.description: true: only recipes with nutrition data; false: only those without.

has_protein.description: true: contains protein; false: the data says zero protein.

has_video.description: true: only recipes with a video link (the creator's YouTube video).

have.description: Ingredients the person has; ranks recipes by how many are covered (staples such as salt and oil are not counted as missing)

ingredient.description: Comma list of ingredients that must all appear (for example lentils,onions).

ingredient_any.description: Comma list of ingredients, at least one must appear.

ingredients_max.description: Maximum number of ingredients (use for "few ingredients").

kids.description: true: kid-friendly recipes. The Cooking with Kids recipes (written for children, with an age band and the steps a grown-up must do) come first;

kids_age.description: Age band of the Cooking with Kids recipes: 3-5, 6-8 or 9+, or an age in years such as 7. Implies kids=true.

lang.description: Language for titles and, where available, ingredient names and step wording:

level.description: Verification level: V0 described only, not machine-verified;

max_missing.description: With have: most missing ingredients allowed (default 3)

method.description: Comma list, any may match. Names or aliases:

min_have.description: With have: fewest of your ingredients a recipe must cover

no_allergens.description: true: only recipes with no major allergen in the declared list or the ingredient names (not a guarantee;

operation.description: Comma list of cooking operations that must all appear: mix, cut, knead, whisk, boil, fry, bake, roast, grill, chill, freeze, marinate, stuff...

prep_time_max.description: Maximum hands-on (active) minutes: the time someone actually works. Same as active_max.

protein_density_min.description: Minimum share of calories from protein, 0 to 1 (0.3 is high protein).

q.description: Words in the dish name, tags or ingredients. Tolerates typos and accents (for example "bachamel" finds béchamel).

serves.description: Feeds at least this many people (same as servings_min).

serves_max.description: Feeds at most this many people.

sodium_max.description: Maximum sodium mg per serving (few recipes have it).

sort.description: relevance (default with q), name, kcal, protein, total_kcal, total_protein, fat, carbs, fiber, sugar, cost, time, prep_time, cook_time, ingredients...

source.description: Who the recipe comes from, by name: "Fatma Abu Haty", "Samia Abdennour", "Chef Teta", "Osool El Tahy", "family archive", or a website for the world...

style.description: hot (uses heat), cold (chilled or frozen only), no_cook (no heat and no chilling step), mixed (heat and chilling).

tag.description: Comma list of exact tags from /api/facets (for example Baking, Soups, Grilling, No Cook). All must match.

time_max.description: Maximum total minutes (only recipes that state a time).

total_kcal_max.description: Maximum calories for the whole recipe.

total_kcal_min.description: Minimum calories for the WHOLE recipe (per-serving kcal times servings).

total_protein_max.description: Maximum protein g for the whole recipe.

total_protein_min.description: Minimum protein g for the whole recipe.
